priorityList: Cast Felblade with If Inertia ready. Notes If Felblade isn't available, Cast Fel Rush instead.
Cast The Hunt. Notes Make sure you've spent any active Reaver procs before casting.
Cast Reaver if you have no active Reaver's Mark. Notes Follow this up with Cast Chaos Strike / Cast Annihilation to apply it.
Cast Immolation Aura If at 2 charges.
Cast Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative. Notes Always align with Cast Eye Beam.
Cast Essence Break while in Cast Metamorphosis. Notes Aim to fill with Cast Death Sweeps and Cast Annihilation.
Cast Metamorphosis with Cast Eye Beam and Cast Death Sweep on cooldown.
Cast Reaver. Rules Only cast this if Glaive Flurry and Rending Strike are not active.
Cast Fel Rush with nothing else available. In Midnight, Fury is scarce so it fills empty GCDs.
